Lena (People Ops): @here Townhall this Fri 10:00 AM PT — quick agenda + logistics. Please drop questions in this thread or add to the form: https://forms.gle/RedwoodTownhallQnA
Priya Desai (Product): Adding: dedicated launch status + perf slides. I can share deck by Thu EOD.
Marco Chen (Eng): I'll do a 5–7 min incident summary (recent autoscaler flaps) and what changed in the runbook.
Andre Vogel (CEO): I’ll open with brief company health, hiring cadence, and a short product push. Keeping it tight.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): Can we squeeze in 2 short customer stories (1 enterprise, 1 startup)? They help frame the Dedicated ask.
Samira R. (Support): Will collect top support tickets and themes — dropping a short list here by Wed.
Lena (People Ops): Note on format: 30 min total. 12 min exec/product, 8 min engineering, 8 min customer/ops, 10 min live Q&A. Recording + transcript will be posted to #all-hands after the call.
Priya Desai (Product): Quick Q: can we include a slide on billing options for Dedicated? Customers keep asking about burst vs reserved pricing.
Marco Chen (Eng): @Priya yes — also plan to mention rollback/fallback policy we added last week.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with the customer that wants to present — pinging them now to confirm availability.
Lena (People Ops): Please post your 2–3 priority questions here by Wed noon so we can prioritize the Q&A queue.
allhands-bot: :bell: Reminder scheduled — Townhall Fri 10:00 AM PT. A calendar invite was sent to everyone.
Lena (People Ops): Small ops note: if you need captions, enable CC in the meeting settings or DM me.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Thanks everyone. Short ask to leads: come with one measurable takeaway for your area.
Priya Desai (Product): Slide deck uploaded: https://redwood.share/drive/townhall-priay-2026 (v1). Will update with numbers Thu.
Marco Chen (Eng): Incident summary doc: https://confluence.redwood/eng/incidents/2026-03-autoscaler. TL;DR: mis-sized jobs -> throttling loop; fixed autoscaler thresholds.
Samira R. (Support): Support top themes: billing confusion, edge-case rate limiting, small-model latency spikes. Will add examples.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks — final reminder: submit top Qs by Wed 12:00. If you want to demo, tell me by Thu morning so we can allocate time.
Lena (People Ops): (follow-up after meeting) Recording posted: https://redwood.co/recordings/3938456789-townhall. Key takeaways posted below.
Lena (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated pilot starts next month (select customers). 2) SLA pilot target 99.95% for critical routes. 3) Autoscaler thresholds patched; improved observability. 4) Support to publish billing FAQ next week.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): Great meeting — customer demo went well, they liked the burst option.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Appreciate the concision — next check-in in 6 weeks.
Lena (People Ops): Closing notes: actions assigned in the doc — I’ll post the action list and owners to #all-hands shortly. :white_check_mark:
